name: Julia Lab
desc: A Julia-set explorer: fix c and vary the starting point z0, rendering the filled Julia set with escape-time coloring and connectedness readouts.
controls: c-real, c-imag and max-iterations sliders, four presets (rabbit/siegel/spiral/dendrite), reset button, move cursor to probe z0; keys 1–4 load presets, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
